chemistry-killer-09.title: For constant temperature and
chemistry-killer-09.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-killer-09.material: For constant temperature and pressure, for di reaction $\mathrm{aA(g) + bB(g) \rightarrow cC(g)}$ wey gas A and B dey react to form gas C, 20 mL of A and 60 mL of B react without excess or shortage to form 40 mL of C. Di molecular mass of A na 28, di molecular mass of B na 2, and dem react 100 mL of mixed gas of A and B (average molecular mass 12.4) completely for di same temperature and pressure. Di density of di gas mixture after di reaction na how many times di density before di reaction?
chemistry-killer-09.s.s1.prompt: For constant temperature and pressure, for di reaction $\mathrm{aA(g) + bB(g) \rightarrow cC(g)}$ wey gas A and B dey react to form gas C, 20 mL of A and 60 mL of B react without excess or shortage to form 40 mL of C. Di molecular mass of A na 28, di molecular mass of B na 2, and dem react 100 mL of mixed gas of A and B (average molecular mass 12.4) completely for di same temperature and pressure. Di density of di gas mixture after di reaction na how many times di density before di reaction?
chemistry-killer-09.s.s1.explain:
Step 1: Volume ratio A:B:C = 20:60:40 = 1:3:2, dat is $\mathrm{A + 3B \rightarrow 2C}$.
Step 2: For di 100 mL of mixed gas, di volume of A na x: (28x + 2(100 − x))/100 = 12.4 → 26x + 200 = 1240 → x = 40 mL. So A 40 mL, B 60 mL.
Step 3: If all di B 60 mL react, A 20 mL go finish and C 40 mL go form. After di reaction A 20 mL + C 40 mL = 60 mL.
Step 4: Mass dey conserved (check with molecular mass: before di reaction 40×28 + 60×2 = 1240, after di reaction di molecular mass of C na (28+3×2)/2 = 17, 20×28 + 40×17 = 1240). For di same temperature and pressure, density = mass/volume, so after/before = 100/60 = 5/3.
Answer: 5/3 (a). (Wrong answers: 3/5 na value wey dem write di ratio upside down, 1 na value wey look only at conservation of mass and ignore di change in volume, and 5/4 na value wey dem wrongly see A as 40 mL remaining and calculate total 80 mL)

chemistry-killer-09.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
